719-3000-3510-3875.easyPrerequisites:
You can cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
Saproling has been chosen with Xenograft.
719-3000-3510-3875.description:
Cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
Each creature or land that entered is a Saproling through Xenograft and a Forest in addition to its other types due to and Life and Limb, causing Tireless Provisioner to trigger that many times.
Resolve a Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating the stated artifact tokens plus at least one creature token through Chatterfang.
Repeat steps 2-3. Unless you have a way to remove one of the pieces, this will cause an infinite mandatory loop and draw the game.

240-574-3480-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Vish Kal ability, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Vish Kal equal to the sacrificed creature's power
Repeat from step 2.
240-574-3480-5470.notes: Depending on how many counters this combo puts on Vish Kal, you can activate its last ability to kill some number of creatures.

1981-2403-2415-7272.notablePrerequisites: You have at least four card types in your graveyard.
1981-2403-2415-7272.description:
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Moonlit Wake and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Moonlit Wake trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve Reaper of Flight Moonsilver's ability, giving it +2/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

1308-2557-4826-6753-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Archelos.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

4-1170-1636-7526.description:
Cast Twofold Intent using Hoarding Broodhoard's convoke ability by tapping creatures you control.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Quill-Blade Laureate.
When Quill-Blade Laureate enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures you control.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-4264-4284.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-4264-4284.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Altered Ego and Clone each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Altered Ego trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Clone trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-4264-4284.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

1003-3652-4973-6516.easyPrerequisites:
It is an opponent's turn.
One of the {0}-cost creatures must be in your hand, with the other being on the battlefield.
1003-3652-4973-6516.description:
During an opponent's turn, cast the {0}-cost creature in your hand by paying {0}.
Glen Elendra Pranksters triggers, returning the other {0}-cost creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the spell from step 1.
Repeat.

129-1409-4289-7175.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Kinnan triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

4350-5686-6972.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Butcher Ghoul
When Butcher Ghoul dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Butcher Ghoul
When Butcher Ghoul dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Butcher Ghoul enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness. Its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 4.
4350-5686-6972.notes: If Butcher Ghoul starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 4 instead.

856-2034-5776-7422.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Garrison Excavator trigger.
Resolve the Garrison Excavator trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

1116-3240-5670-7173.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
1116-3240-5670-7173.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by sacrificing Nether Traitor and paying 1 life.
When Nether Traitor dies, Sek'Kuar triggers, creating a 3/1 Graveborn creature token.
When the Graveborn enters the battlefield, Virulent Emissary triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the Graveborn.
When the Graveborn dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Nether Traitor enters the battlefield, Virulent Emissary triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

338-2034-3490-4210.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-2034-3490-4210.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Pious Evangel triggers if it's on the battlefield.
Regardless, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}
When the Servo dies, Wayward Disciple triggers if it's on the battlefield.
Resolve either the Pious Evangel or Wayward Disciple trigger, causing you to gain life and target opponent to lose 1 life if Wayward Disciple triggered.
Repeat from step 2.

requires.n: Cards Allowing a Creature to Tap for Free

3384-4067-6827--119.easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
3384-4067-6827--119.description:
Tap Spider-Gwen using any free method.
Spider-Gwen triggers, causing you to discard a card and draw two cards.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Spider-Gwen.
Repeat.
3384-4067-6827--119.notes: This combo will net near-infinite results from the method used to tap Spider-Gwen. The no summoning sickness requirement could also be bypassed depending on the method used.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with a +1/+1 counter on it and has lifelink

1495-3226-4613.description:
Activate Blood Researcher by using Triskelion's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain 1 life due to its lifelink.
Blood Researcher triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

222-527-5147-5295.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-5147-5295.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Goblin Bombardment twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

1170-6513.easyPrerequisites:
An opponent has an instant or sorcery in their graveyard.
You have a noncreature spell in hand with the mana to cast it.
1170-6513.description:
Cast any noncreature spell by casting its mana cost.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Chancellor of the Spires.
When Chancellor of the Spires enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to cast an instant or sorcery from an opponent's graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 2 for each remaining instant and/or sorcery card in each opponent's graveyard that you wish to cast.
Resolve all spells on the stack.
You may repeat this loop whenever you cast a noncreature spell.
1170-6513.notes: You can start this loop by casting Chancellor of the Spires and resolving its ETB ability instead, and then follow the above instructions for every subsequent loop.

11-799-3942-6276.manaNeeded: {2}{U}{U}{U} plus enough mana to cast the extra turn spell each turn
11-799-3942-6276.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one legendary creature and/or planeswalker.
You have max speed.
11-799-3942-6276.description:
Cast Karn's Temporal Sundering by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Narset's Reversal by paying {U}{U}, targeting Karn's Temporal Sundering.
Holding priority, activate Slick Imitator by paying {1} and sacrificing it, copying Narset's Reversal, with the copy targeting the original Narset's Reversal.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, copying the original Narset's Reversal targeting Karn's Temporal Sundering, and returning the original Narset's Reversal to your hand.
Resolve Karn's Temporal Sundering, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Slick Imitator from your graveyard by paying {1}{U}.
Repeat each turn.
11-799-3942-6276.notes: If you've cast a creature spell using Karador this turn, you may move to your extra turn, and then do step 6 followed by steps 1-5.

654-1575-5903.manaNeeded: {2} if you don't control a Treasure
654-1575-5903.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one other artifact.
654-1575-5903.description:
If you control a Treasure, activate it by sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color. If you don't control a Treasure, activate another artifact by paying {2}, tapping and sacrificing it.
Nuka-Cola Vending Machine triggers, creating a tapped Treasure token that is also a Food due to Gourmand's Talent.
When the Treasure enters the battlefield, Amulet of Vigor triggers, untapping the Treasure.
If needed, resolve the ability from step 1, causing you to gain 3 life.
Repeat.

81-3933-4929-5479.notablePrerequisites:
Lost Jitte has at least one charge counter on it.
Cryptic Trilobite has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
81-3933-4929-5479.description:
Activate Karn's Bastion by paying {4}, putting a charge counter on Lost Jitte and two +1/+1 counters on Cryptic Trilobite.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Lost Jitte by removing a charge counter from it, untapping Karn's Bastion.
Repeat.

1379-2308-4063-4659.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing another creature, adding {C}{C}.
Fleshtaker triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and scry 1.
Trudge Garden triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a 4/4 Fungus Beast creature token.
Repeat.

643-1636-4117-4302.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one other creature.
Visara the Dreadful does not have summoning sickness.
643-1636-4117-4302.description:
Activate Visara the Dreadful by tapping it, destroying another creature you control.
When the creature dies as an Angel due to Maskwood Nexus, Bishop of Wings' second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit enters the battlefield as an Angel due to Maskwood Nexus, Bishop of Wings' first ability and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Bishop of Wings trigger, causing you to gain 4 life.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

738-1646-4659-5034-5111.notablePrerequisites: An opponent controls a creature with toughness equal to one.
738-1646-4659-5034-5111.description:
Activate Sol Ring by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Acorn Catapult by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting a creature an opponent controls with toughness equal to one.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing Sol Ring and Acorn Catapult, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Acorn Catapult ability, dealing 1 damage to the creature, causing it to die due to having zero toughness, and causing its controller to create a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the opponent's creature dies, Glissa triggers twice, returning Acorn Catapult and Sol Ring from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Acorn Catapult and Sol Ring by paying {5}.
Repeat.

379-2125-3939-4425.notablePrerequisites:
Varragoth and Canal Dredger do not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block and kill Varragoth.
379-2125-3939-4425.description:
Cast Temporal Extortion by paying {B}{B}{B}{B}.
Temporal Extortion and Mirari trigger.
Resolve the Mirari trigger, paying {3} and copying Temporal Extortion.
Resolve the Temporal Extortion copy, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Resolve the Temporal Extortion trigger, allowing any player to pay half their life to counter the spell.
If no one does, resolve Temporal Extortion, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Canal Dredger by tapping it, putting Temporal Extortion on the bottom of your library.
Declare Varragoth as an attacker.
Pay {1}{B} to activate Varragoth, searching your library for Temporal Extortion and putting it on top.
Repeat each turn.

3750-4538-5231.notablePrerequisites:
Dune-Brood Nephilim does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent is unable to block Dune-Brood Nephilim.
You control at least six lands.
3750-4538-5231.description:
Deal combat damage with Dune-Brood Nephilim.
Dune-Brood Nephilim triggers, creating a 1/1 Sand creature token for each land you control.
Proceed to your postcombat main phase.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing five Sand tokens, adding {3}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, untapping all creatures you control and getting an additional combat phase and main phase after this phase.
Repeat.

2441-4050-5003.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Rasputin Dreamweaver, adding {C}{C}.
Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Rasputin Dreamweaver from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Activate Rasputin Dreamweaver's first activated ability seven times by removing seven dream counters from it, adding seven {C}.
Repeat any number of times.
Once you have infinite mana, you may repeat this loop with any other creatures you control, effectively blinking them through sacrifice and reanimation.
